Cameron Green earns an extended run after scoring his maiden home Test century.

Green's Century Breakthrough

#Cricket #Aletheia

Captain Pat Cummins confirmed Cameron Green will secure an extended run at number five after scoring a brilliant 104 against Bangladesh in Darwin.

Cameron Green's 104 in the second innings broke an 11-innings dry spell, cementing his place in the Test squad as Australia prepares for the second Test in Mackay.

Green rediscovered his natural rhythm, providing a blueprint for success in future Test matches.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing the WHAT of individual statistical success with the WHO of collective team victory. Green excelled while the broader batting lineup collapsed.

Transparent feedback and returning to foundational mechanics allowed Green to overcome external criticism and anchor his performance in proven technique.
